Minnesota Twins        7    @

Vladimir Guerrero Jr. out on a sacrifice fly to center fielder James Outman. George Springer scores.

Alejandro Kirk singles on a sharp line drive to right fielder Matt Wallner. Nathan Lukes scores. Bo Bichette to 3rd.

Bottom 2 - Minnesota Twins: 0, Toronto Blue Jays: 3

George Springer homers (24) on a fly ball to left center field.
Bottom 5 - Minnesota Twins: 0, Toronto Blue Jays: 4

Luke Keaschall homers (3) on a line drive to left center field. Brooks Lee scores.
Top 6 - Minnesota Twins: 2, Toronto Blue Jays: 4

Brooks Lee flies into a sacrifice double play, right fielder Addison Barger to second baseman Andrés Giménez to shortstop Bo Bichette. Mickey Gasper scores. Austin Martin out at 2nd.
Top 7 - Minnesota Twins: 3, Toronto Blue Jays: 4

Mickey Gasper homers (1) on a fly ball to right field.
Top 9 - Minnesota Twins: 4, Toronto Blue Jays: 4

Matt Wallner homers (20) on a fly ball to right center field. Austin Martin scores. Brooks Lee scores.
Top 9 - Minnesota Twins: 7, Toronto Blue Jays: 4

Daulton Varsho doubles (9) on a line drive to center fielder James Outman. George Springer scores.
Bottom 9 - Minnesota Twins: 7, Toronto Blue Jays: 5
